_comment: Resource-name templates for SDK methods whose `name`/`parent` docstring states no format and whose format cannot be inferred from sibling methods (see extract.py: _expand_resource_name_params). Keys are <service module>: {"<ApiClass>.<method>.<param>": "<template>"}. Templates use {placeholder} segments that become typed path parameters. Keys starting with `_` are comments.

networking._endpoints: The SDK documents the endpoint `parent` as accounts/{account_id} and lists endpoints at accounts/{account_id}/endpoints; the endpoint resource name is the child of that collection.
networking.EndpointsAPI.get_endpoint.name: accounts/{account_id}/endpoints/{endpoint_id}
networking.EndpointsAPI.delete_endpoint.name: accounts/{account_id}/endpoints/{endpoint_id}
networking._gateways: The SDK documents the gateway name as accounts/{account_id}/network-connectivity-configs/{ncc_id}/private-network-gateways/{gateway_id}; its parent is the network connectivity configuration.
